# Reduced CPU vision execution oracle

Generated by `python3 scripts/mm/gen_gemma4_vision_golden.py` with installed
Torch 2.11.0+cu130, revision 70d99e998b4955e0049d13a98d77ae1b14db1f45,
CPU only, one Torch thread. No downloaded weights or package installation.
`model.safetensors` is deterministic synthetic BF16, not a model checkpoint.

Independent equations transcribe Transformers
`a08ace4bbd97e721c98751deec37d87b026acadc`,
`src/transformers/models/gemma4/modeling_gemma4.py`:
Gemma4ClippableLinear, Gemma4RMSNorm, Gemma4VisionPatchEmbedder,
Gemma4VisionAttention, apply_multidimensional_rope, Gemma4VisionMLP,
Gemma4VisionEncoderLayer, Gemma4VisionPooler, Gemma4MultimodalEmbedder.
Retained source SHA256:
`ccab8e2dd80b71e9ca34e2c87291e17c40a27c755006e554da2ebf70d6616916`.
The generator does not run or import C++ and does not import a full HF model.

One nonzero MHA block: hidden/head width 4, one head, intermediate 6,
patch16/pool3, position table32, text width2. Each linear has different input
and output clipping bounds. Learned norms are nonuniform and nonzero.
The small 3x6 patch grid covers both position axes and two pooled outputs.
A second independent 384x384 patterned RGB example covers 576 valid patches,
64 soft tokens and trailing padding through the production processor/registry.
Original E4B uses 12/12 MHA heads and width768/head64; this fixture does not
establish original-shape or original-checkpoint numeric acceptance. In
particular head_dim4 has one frequency per axis, so general theta dependence
is not numerically established by this fixture.

Compare every finite stage value: patch absolute tolerance .004,
attention/MLP/encoder/pool .032, small connector .008, full processed image
connector .016. These thresholds were fixed before production correction;
none were relaxed to obtain GREEN. They allow reduced BF16 CPU fused-op versus
unfused Torch rounding differences (RoPE products and attention probabilities),
not exact HF eager equivalence or a ratified original-model numerical bar.
Pool matches the source cast-to-BF16 before float32 sqrt(hidden) scaling.
Clipping, missing positions and missing connector normalization mutations fail.
Full HF/vLLM compatibility, factory registration, device execution, original
weights and served acceptance remain pending. SupportsMmInputs remains false.
